units.source_text: 我认识的所有雄河童都被雌河童追逐过，无一例外。

en.t: Every male kappa I knew had been chased by female kappa, without a single exception.

units.source_text: 即便是已经结了婚的巴咯也被追逐过，而且还被捉住了两三次。

en.t: Even Baro, who was already married, had been chased, and had even been caught two or three times.

units.source_text: 唯一没被捉住过的是一个被称作马咯的哲学家，他也是诗人托喀的邻居。

en.t: The only one who had never been caught was a philosopher called Maro, who was also the neighbor of the poet Toka.

units.source_text: 至于原因，其一是马咯长得无比丑陋，其二是马咯很少上街，总是宅在家里。

en.t: As for the reasons, first, Maro was exceedingly ugly, and second, he rarely went out into the street and always stayed shut up at home.

units.source_text: 我也经常去马咯家串门聊天。

en.t: I too often went over to Maro's house to visit and chat.

units.source_text: 马咯的房间有些幽暗，他喜欢在屋里点上七彩玻璃灯，爬在高脚桌子上拼命读一本很厚的书。

en.t: Maro's room was somewhat dim, and he liked to light a seven-colored glass lamp inside, climb up onto a high-legged desk, and read a very thick book with all his might.

units.source_text: 我和马咯也讨论过一次河童的恋爱。

en.t: Maro and I also once discussed the love affairs of kappa.
